title: CloudDash SLA and support response times
content:
## Uptime SLA

| Plan | Uptime Guarantee | Compensation |
|------|-----------------|---------------|
| Starter | 99.5% | Service credit |
| Pro | 99.9% | Service credit |
| Enterprise | 99.99% | Service credit + SLA review |

Downtime is measured monthly. Credits are applied automatically to the next invoice.

## Support response times

| Priority | Starter | Pro | Enterprise |
|----------|---------|-----|------------|
| Critical (system down) | 24 hours | 4 hours | 1 hour |
| High (major feature broken) | 48 hours | 8 hours | 2 hours |
| Medium (degraded functionality) | 72 hours | 24 hours | 4 hours |
| Low (question/request) | 5 days | 48 hours | 24 hours |

## Support channels
- **Starter**: Email only
- **Pro**: Email and live chat (business hours, Mon–Fri 9am–6pm UTC)
- **Enterprise**: Email, live chat, dedicated Slack channel, and phone

## Reporting downtime
If you experience downtime, open a ticket at support.clouddash.io with your account ID and the time range. Our team will investigate and apply credits within 5 business days if the SLA was breached.
